name: Electronic (house, EDM)
description: A house or EDM track: long intro and outro for DJs to mix, and two build-ups into drops around a breakdown. 96 bars.

sections.name: Intro
sections.tip: Drums and a few elements, simple enough for a DJ to mix in.

sections.name: Build-up
sections.tip: Raise the energy: risers, a snare roll, open a filter.

sections.name: Drop
sections.tip: Everything hits on the first beat: full drums, bass and the main lead.

sections.name: Breakdown
sections.tip: Strip back to pads, chords or a vocal, and let the ear rest before the next build.

sections.name: Build-up
sections.tip: Build again, bigger than the first time: risers, rolls, a rising filter.

sections.name: Drop
sections.tip: The second drop: the same energy, with a change to keep it fresh.

sections.name: Outro
sections.tip: Take parts out until the drums are left, so a DJ can mix out.
